audience: fundraisers and donor-care staff who keep donors and gifts in Bloomerang

useCases.title: Find a donor and review their giving history
useCases.text: The AI searches constituents by name or email, opens the profile and reads the timeline of gifts, interactions, notes and tasks.

useCases.title: List gifts by fund, campaign or appeal
useCases.text: The AI lists transactions (donations, pledges, recurring gifts) filtered by constituent, amount range or type, with the fund, campaign and appeal of each.

useCases.title: See which tasks are due and who has them
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks filtered by status, due-date range, assignee or constituent. You get the follow-ups to do first.

useCases.title: Review past interactions and notes
useCases.text: The AI lists interactions (calls, emails, meetings, letters) by constituent, channel or purpose, and the notes on a record.

useCases.title: Log an interaction or note, or add a task
useCases.text: The AI logs a call, email or meeting, adds a note to a constituent's record, or creates a follow-up task assigned to a user.

useCases.title: Add or update a constituent
useCases.text: The AI searches first to avoid a duplicate, then creates an individual or organization, or updates names, job, status, address, email or phone.
